scope: Cats full-game implementation plan; no game implementation is complete

tickets.title: Create and resume a private saved household
tickets.delivers: An invited player signs in, names a household, saves it to real storage, and resumes it after signing out.
criteria: Reject uninvited, expired-session and cross-owner reads/writes on every server endpoint.
Double-tapping Create makes one household; stable identity and name survive reload.
Provision isolated real development auth/database before SDK wiring; do not replace them with production demo data.
Deliver usable desktop and phone entry, loading, retry and sign-out states.

tickets.title: Select and move an animated cat in the approved world
tickets.delivers: Open a rendered home, select a cat, and move it around furniture by touch or mouse.
criteria: Use separate sprites, tiles, collision and controls; the approved picture is never the playable background.
Selection updates a DOM cat panel and movement follows reachable paths without teleporting through objects.
Pan, zoom, selection, cancel and pointer-cancel work on desktop and phone without hover-only actions.
Position persists, unreachable paths explain failure, and renderer loss offers recovery.

tickets.title: Resume safely across devices and pause while away
tickets.delivers: Automatically save, switch devices and resume without doubled time or competing writers.
criteria: Enforce one writer with server-issued lease epoch, TTL, renewal and explicit takeover; reject stale writers.
Use revision CAS and request idempotency; a lost response retried after commit cannot write twice.
Pause on close, hidden tab, lost lease or connectivity loss; no wall-clock catch-up after resuming.
Retain a local conflict recovery copy and show Saving/Saved/Reconnecting honestly.

tickets.title: Create real or imaginary cats
tickets.delivers: Create named cats with visible coats, body details and personality traits, then save them.
criteria: Creator inventory supports real-cat recreation and fictional cats; preview changes affect sprite and portrait.
Enforce eight living cats plus reserved unborn slots; ninth creation changes nothing.
Support Unicode names, reject blank/unsafe input, and keep phone keyboard from obscuring confirmation.
Persist canonical appearance/trait IDs and migrate safely if a catalog entry changes.

tickets.title: Feed, rest, play and care for cats
tickets.delivers: Use real objects to satisfy hunger, energy, fun, social, hygiene and bladder needs.
criteria: Each action navigates, reserves an anchor, animates, takes simulation time and applies an observable need effect.
Queue, cancel and interrupted/removed/occupied targets release reservations and unused resources.
Bowl, bed, toy, litter and grooming objects all work end to end and persist their state.
Paused/closed games do not decay needs; UI rendering never advances simulation time.

tickets.title: Watch personalities and free will shape behavior
tickets.delivers: Unselected cats independently choose care, social actions, play, naps and mischief.
criteria: Use trait/need utility, seeded tie-breaks and cooldowns; persist RNG and current action.
Different traits produce distinguishable choices in an observable multi-cat fixture.
Prevent oscillation, starvation loops, double-reserved objects and endless unreachable-route attempts.
Player suggestions use the same domain validation; refusals are visible and do not coerce another cat.

tickets.title: Buy, place, recolor, move, rotate and sell furniture
tickets.delivers: Decorate the real home with functional objects paid for using household money.
criteria: Touch and mouse support preview, rotate, confirm, cancel, move, sell and authored color/style variants.
Validate footprints, wall/door overlap, anchors and walkability before an atomic debit and placement.
Insufficient funds, occupied objects and rejected edits give reasons; retries never double-charge.
Changed layouts persist and cats actually use moved furniture.

tickets.title: Build the floor plan, rooms and finishes
tickets.delivers: Create and reshape rooms with walls, doors, windows, floor finishes and wall colors.
criteria: Allow editing the home lot topology rather than decorating fixed rooms.
Preview and atomically commit itemized build costs; invalid geometry or funds restore exact prior state.
Recompute room boundaries, occlusion, anchors and paths after edits.
Provide explicit touch start/end/confirm controls and equivalent keyboard/mouse workflow.

tickets.title: Undo and demolish without trapping cats
tickets.delivers: Pause to build, undo/redo within a build session, and safely resume household activity.
criteria: Reject walls on cats, stranded entrances and inaccessible required/occupied anchors with a visible highlight.
Cancel restores the whole transaction; undo/redo includes geometry and cost.
Invalidate routes after edits; resuming replans against the current topology.
Undo cannot cross a live simulation/save epoch, restore a dead cat or duplicate money/items.

tickets.title: Offer free-build without money exploits
tickets.delivers: Opt into free decorating, then return to normal earned progression.
criteria: Free-build changes build cost/catalog access only; it does not disable needs, age or death.
Free objects have persistent provenance and zero resale; free demolition gives no normal refund.
Free placement never grants earned goals/unlocks; leaving mode does not charge retroactively.
Mode and pending edits survive safe reload, and its effect is clearly visible.

tickets.title: Paint, improve and sell artwork
tickets.delivers: Use an easel to grow painting skill and create art that can be displayed or sold.
criteria: Work duration, skill and seeded quality produce a real persistent artwork.
Cancel or loss of the easel preserves partial progress without duplication.
Display creates a placeable artwork; idempotent sale removes it and credits exactly once.
Skill, product provenance and work-in-progress survive device switch.

tickets.title: Grow, harvest and sell produce
tickets.delivers: Buy seeds, plant, water, harvest and sell three distinct crops.
criteria: Growth and withering use simulation time; nothing advances while away.
Care affects yield; harvest puts real products into inventory.
Handle missing tools, occupied beds, full inventory and removed plants without losing unrelated items.
Purchase/harvest/sale retries cannot duplicate products or make funds negative.

tickets.title: Work scheduled careers and earn promotions
tickets.delivers: Choose among three careers, attend shifts, earn wages and advance through three ranks.
criteria: Each track defines schedules, skill criteria, wages and explicit promotion requirements.
Departure, attendance, return and payment are real saved activities, with wages issued once.
Handle lateness, low needs, job changes, dismissal, interruption and death without phantom pay.
Career UI explains progress on phone and desktop; off-camera work shares the paused world clock.

tickets.title: Complete goals and unlock content
tickets.delivers: Track meaningful care, building, skill and career goals and earn rewards.
criteria: Show prerequisite and progress for each goal and locked item.
Rewards key off domain achievements and are granted once across retries/devices.
Free-build actions do not counterfeit earned goals; rewards cannot be claimed repeatedly.
Register later social, family, business and neighborhood goals under the same event contract.

tickets.title: Travel to a lively persistent neighborhood
tickets.delivers: Leave home, visit the park and see other cats while the household continues off-camera.
criteria: Connect home, park, residential homes, shop and café using actual navigable routes.
Travel takes simulation time and can fail/cancel with recovery; return preserves state.
Off-camera household activity uses one shared clock, not duplicate independent simulation loops.
NPC identities, routines, traits and locations persist instead of respawning each visit.

tickets.title: Shop and visit neighborhood homes
tickets.delivers: Enter shops, buy goods and visit other cats at home.
criteria: Purchases commit stock, inventory and funds together.
Hours, invitations/access and object permissions govern entry and use.
Visiting NPC homes does not grant build ownership; all mutation commands check lot ownership.
Closed shops, depleted stock, capacity, interrupted travel and insufficient money have actionable states.

tickets.title: Develop friendships, rivalries and memories
tickets.delivers: Socialize with household and neighborhood cats, forming persistent bonds and rivalries.
criteria: Implement initiation, recipient response, animations, cooldown and mood/relationship effects.
Friendship/rivalry meaningfully changes autonomous behavior.
Show known cats and memorable events in an accessible relationship panel.
Move-out, death, cancellation and scene transitions retain identities and avoid dangling references.

tickets.title: Fall in love with mutual readiness
tickets.delivers: Adult cats develop mutual romantic bonds and accept or decline affection.
criteria: Reciprocal affection is required; one-sided affection is not mutual love.
Check age, family links, health, needs, mood, availability and pair cooldown for both cats.
Player and autonomous proposals use the same eligibility function at execution time.
Declines explain why, respect cooldown and cannot trigger a pregnancy roll.

tickets.title: Moo-Moo, chance pregnancy and safe birth
tickets.delivers: Willing cats in love can Moo-Moo and sometimes conceive and later welcome kittens.
criteria: Use exactly Moo-Moo; keep its presentation discreet and non-graphic.
Player or cats may initiate, but both must be willing/in love/in mood at start and completion.
Roll conception once per completed eligible action with persisted seeded RNG; declined/canceled attempts never roll.
At eight occupied/reserved spaces Moo-Moo still works without pregnancy; at seven a new litter reserves at most one slot.
Reserve litter size at conception; creation, adoption and simultaneous conception share capacity checks; birth atomically exchanges slots for kittens.
Persist pregnancy, parents, due time, RNG and birth idempotency; retries, reload and interruptions cannot duplicate kittens.

tickets.title: Raise kittens and follow generations
tickets.delivers: Name and care for kittens, see inherited looks/traits and navigate the family tree.
criteria: Store both parent identities, inheritance and life stage even after death or move-out.
Kitten care and animations work; kittens cannot work, romance or Moo-Moo.
Family tree distinguishes living, deceased and moved-out members and prevents close-relative romance.
Handle pregnancy-carrier death and interrupted birth with released reservations and no orphaned state.

tickets.title: Age at a fixed pace and face old age
tickets.delivers: Progress through kitten, adolescent, adult and elder stages on one moderately relaxed lifespan.
criteria: Use documented fixed durations; no lifespan selector or aging setting.
Only active simulation advances age; elder milestones give notice of old-age death.
Death is once-only and stops work/actions/romance, releases living capacity and preserves history.
If the last cat dies, keep the house/save and offer adoption rather than resetting.

tickets.title: Treat illness and respond to danger
tickets.delivers: Illness, severe neglect and a kitchen-fire accident can be treated or lead to permanent death.
criteria: Symptoms and warnings precede consequences; offer meaningful treatment/rescue rather than unavoidable per-frame death rolls.
Interventions change outcomes through actual cost, action duration, world state and save behavior.
Closed/hidden games never advance hazard timers; recovery cancels the matching pending event.
Concurrent causes create one death record and do not duplicate memorials or clear unrelated state.

tickets.title: Memorialize cats and receive ghost visits
tickets.delivers: Place memorials, read memories and receive occasional visits from deceased cats.
criteria: Create one memorial per death and preserve it when moved/stored.
Ghost chance and visit cooldown use simulation nights and seeded RNG.
Ghosts remain deceased, consume no living slots, cannot work/conceive and never restore life.
Reload does not duplicate a visit; living cats can react and family history remains intact.

tickets.title: Own and operate a cat café
tickets.delivers: Buy the café business, stock it, serve orders and earn net profit.
criteria: Implement ownership, hours, supplies, three recipes/products, customer orders, service and a profit summary.
Revenue subtracts actual stock/costs; no infinite free customers or repeated order payouts.
Handle closure, absent/dead owner, low needs, empty stock and interrupted orders.
Customer identities, reputation, ledger and idempotent order settlement persist across devices.

tickets.title: Adopt and move adult cats to neighborhood homes
tickets.delivers: Adopt when there is space or let an adult move out while retaining its identity and relationships.
criteria: Preview adoption and confirm before atomic funds/capacity changes, counting unborn reservations.
Move-out is a confirmed transfer to a residence with a slot, not deletion; the cat remains visitable.
Defer pregnant-cat transfer until birth with a clear explanation; do not cancel pregnancy silently.
Adoption after last-cat death continues the existing home, money, memories and neighborhood.

tickets.title: Make the private gift welcoming and understandable
tickets.delivers: Guide her through play, let her personalize cats and dedication, and control sound.
criteria: Provide a skippable/resumable tutorial for select, care, build, relationships and saves.
Do not invent her name or real-cat identities; editable profiles are usable without missing personal details.
Sound starts after interaction with music/effects controls, mute and reduced-motion support.
Isolate tester saves; reset requires specific confirmation and a recovery snapshot.

tickets.title: Complete coherent game art and content
tickets.delivers: Furnish and play the whole world using the complete initial functional catalog and consistent animation.
criteria: Meet the spec content inventory: creator choices, object functions/variants, locations, NPCs, crops, careers, recipes and goals.
Every item has stable ID, icon, footprint, interaction anchors, cost and runtime assets; no dead buttons or missing textures.
Produce clean consistent sprites/tiles/animation from approved direction; record provenance and manifest hashes.
Inspect all affected desktop and phone states against the approved picture without using the picture as production scenery.

tickets.title: Finish all controls for touch, keyboard and mouse
tickets.delivers: Complete every care/build/social/business action on phones and computers comfortably.
criteria: Portrait/landscape safe areas, keyboard, dialogs and HUD do not hide confirm/cancel or selected cat.
Use 44px targets, readable text, focus management, non-color status cues and DOM alternatives to canvas actions.
Pinch, pan, panel scroll and pointer cancellation never commit build or social actions accidentally.
Open every captured state and fix clipping, overlap, missing stacking and horizontal overflow before acceptance.

tickets.title: Survive migrations, corruption and interrupted saves
tickets.delivers: Upgrade and recover existing households without silent resets or lost generations.
criteria: Version/validate complete state, catalog references, RNG, action queues, family, deaths and businesses.
Migrations are deterministic and transactional with immutable pre-migration backup; future versions are rejected.
Checksum, revision and epoch conflicts show named recovery copies without overwriting the winning cloud save.
Export/import is recovery only; it safely remaps imported ownership and IDs and preserves invariants.

tickets.title: Balance a complete household lifetime
tickets.delivers: Play a complete saga of care, building, work, love, kittens, danger, death and legacy.
criteria: Run deterministic long-duration scenarios and record money, needs, population, pregnancies and mortality.
Early sessions and unlocks are attainable; care/treatment budgets are sustainable without infinite-profit exploits.
Exercise simultaneous conception/adoption/death/reload against the eight-slot invariant across seeded runs.
Tune engineering defaults using measurements while retaining all confirmed scope and fixed lifespan intent.

tickets.title: Blind-review and dogfood the complete game
tickets.delivers: Independently verify every requirement, the art direction, security and real phone/desktop play.
criteria: Map every requirement/story to passing behavior tests or reviewed manual evidence on the exact commit.
Dogfood Chrome/Safari desktop and mobile Safari/Chrome, including real-device smoke and cross-device resume.
Measure full-content scene frame times, input delay, initial load, bounded memory trend and save payload.
Verify private access, owner isolation, writer fencing, no secrets, no production fixtures and no untested visible actions.

tickets.title: Release the verified private gift
tickets.delivers: Deploy privately and verify the accepted game with a rollback path and recipient handoff.
criteria: Require green CI, independent review, viewed desktop/mobile screenshots and complete requirement coverage.
Verify the exact deployment/commit, private access, asset load, unauthorized rejection and cross-device persistence.
Do real recipient sign-in/device acceptance when identity/devices are available; otherwise explicitly report that remaining gate.
Do not send external invitations/messages under Russell's name without explicit authorization; prepare enrollment and private link.
